comments: Colophon cited in [PJ2RPFCM]: 141-142, as reported in [BAQ9MH4T]: 323, n. 161: bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal pos | 'bru mang po'i lo | rta pa'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la | chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du | legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni | lung rigs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i gnas drug pa blo gros mtshungs med kyis bgyis te |
name: byang chub kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa dgongs pa nges par gsal ba
